name: image_edit
description: Edit or transform an existing image based on a text prompt. Supports mask-based editing, transparent backgrounds, and multiple output formats (png, jpeg, webp). Use for image-to-image generation, style transfer, background replacement, or any modification that requires a reference image.

image_path.description: Path to the reference image file (local path or URL).

prompt.description: Text description of the desired edit or transformation to apply to the reference image.

provider.description: Provider connector ID (use image_providers with capability='image_editing' to list). If omitted, the first available image editing provider is used.

model.description: Model name to use. Overrides the provider's default model. If omitted, the provider's default model is used.

output.description: Output file path for the edited image.

mask.description: Path to a mask image defining the edit region. Transparent or semi-transparent areas in the mask indicate where edits should be applied. Accepts local path, URL, workspace://, or attach:// URI.

background.description: Background handling. Use 'transparent' for PNG/WebP images with no background. Default: auto (provider decides).

output_compression.description: Compression level 0-100 for jpeg/webp output. Higher means better quality. Default: 100.

quality.description: Image quality level. Higher quality takes longer to generate. Default: auto.

extra.description: Additional provider-specific parameters as a JSON object. These are passed directly to the provider API. Common keys: moderation (auto|low), input_fidelity (high|low). Use for parameters not covered by the standard fields above.
